description:
Keep nursery essentials within arm's reach with the Addison 3 Drawer Nightstand. Crafted from solid Brown Maple hardwood, this compact nightstand features three smooth-gliding drawers with dovetail construction for lasting durability.

Use it beside the glider to hold burp cloths, pacifiers, and a book, or place it next to the crib for late-night diaper changes and feedings.
